description:
GH: https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam/issues/22

Not a bug — nothing broken, no workaround in use. `bn` is one-shot CLI only,
which is perfect for agents but jialat for a human browsing a big store.
Reporter's store: 909 issues (`bn count`), and `bn epic status` prints 124 lines
flat with no fold, no filter, no drill-in.

Today epic support is only:
    bn epic status          # flat stream, every epic
    bn epic close-eligible
There is no `bn epic list`. To go epic -> children you must leave that output,
run `bn show <id>` / `bn list` per epic, and rebuild the tree in your head.
`bn dep` has the edges but no view that walks them.

Wanted (`bn tui` or `bn browse`):
  * epics as a TREE, expand to child issues inline with status/priority
  * epic progress (n/m children closed) in context, no separate command
  * live filter/search (status, priority, label, assignee, text), tree updates
  * dependency navigation — jump to what blocks this / what this blocks
  * detail pane (description, notes, deps), `bn ready` set highlighted
  * ideally in-place mutations: claim, close, bump priority

Constraints:
  * Termux/Android capability is a stated goal of this fork — ratatui is
    terminal-native so no conflict, but keep the dep set pure-Rust.
  * PER CLAUDE.md: a TUI CANNOT be verified headless. This needs HUMAN
    dogfooding. Build it, but never auto-"fix" its interactive behaviour on the
    strength of a passing test.

Data model already supports all of it — the gap is purely presentational.
title: kopi-beans: add an interactive TUI (bn tui) for browsing epics, children and dependencies
